home.title:
eMaapõu
Explore geological data
home.intro: Discover the stories behind rocks, fossils and landscapes. Explore geological collections, research datasets and places through the SARV geoscience data platform. Connect specimens, samples and scientific records to support research, learning and new discoveries.
home.placesText: Geographical information, drillcores and stratigraphic units.
home.externalNote: Specialist databases and tools open on their own websites.
home.repositoryText: Published geoscience datasets and their supporting files.
home.workbenchText: The data management environment for SARV.

about.title: About eMaapõu
about.subtitle: A window into geological information.
about.intro: eMaapõu provides direct access to geological data hosted in the SARV geoscience data platform, together with links to external resources and applications.
about.dataDescription: Explore geological collections, fossil specimens, rock samples, drillcores, localities, analytical data and photographs. The portal brings these records together with links to specialist databases and publications.
about.searchDescription: Use the global search to get started, or browse a data group to explore a particular topic. Detailed searches let you refine your query, view records on a map, browse images and export data.
about.photo: Sandstone cliffs at Kallaste beside Lake Peipus
about.collectionsText: Physical and digital collections of geological material.
about.researchText: Research material, analytical results and derived datasets.
about.sarvText: SARV is the geoscience data platform behind eMaapõu. Research institutions and museums use it to document, manage and share their collections and research data. The institutions below hold and maintain their own collections; eMaapõu provides a common way to discover their records.
about.servicesText: Open specialist databases and applications on other websites.
about.externalNote: External services open on their own websites.

about.universityOfTartuDepartmentOfGeology: University of Tartu Department of Geology

specimenSearch.intro: Specimens are physical objects preserved in geological collections, such as fossils, rocks and minerals. Explore their catalogue records, identifications and collection localities, with stratigraphic information and photographs where available.
